import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Table, TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { clsx as cn } from 'clsx';

/**
 * A dense editable table (restyle plan G12, Prefab-owned; first user the offer builder's
 * positions): the kit `Table` with compact cells for kit `Input`s, numbers right-aligned, the
 * first column sticky when the table scrolls sideways. Below `md` there is no table to scroll:
 * each row folds into a bordered block of labelled cells (the same DOM — the header's words ride
 * each cell as a phone-only label, hidden from screen readers, whose controls carry their own
 * `aria-label`).
 *
 * `fold="container"` (restyle P4.6b, the drawing review's editor pane) folds by the width of the
 * grid's OWN container instead of the viewport: below 32rem (`@max-lg`) the rows are the labelled
 * blocks, from 32rem a table. A pane beside a drawing is narrow on a wide screen and wide on a
 * stacked tablet, so the viewport says nothing about it. A column's `foldSpan` sets its width in
 * a folded row (six columns; numbers default to half, the rest to the whole row). `headerAction` puts a
 * small control after the header's words in the table header (an apply-to-all), never in the
 * folded labels.
 */
type FoldSpan = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
/** Written out whole so Tailwind generates them. */
const FOLD_SPAN: Record<FoldSpan, string> = {
  1: '@max-lg:col-span-1',
  2: '@max-lg:col-span-2',
  3: '@max-lg:col-span-3',
  4: '@max-lg:col-span-4',
  5: '@max-lg:col-span-5',
  6: '@max-lg:col-span-6',
};

export type ReviewGridColumn<T> = {
  key: string;
  header: string;
  /** A number or money column. */
  numeric?: boolean;
  /** Width classes for the column on a table (`md:w-32`). */
  className?: string;
  /** The phone label is left out (a trailing actions cell). */
  bare?: boolean;
  /** `fold="container"`: the column's width in a folded row, in sixths (numbers 3, the rest 6). */
  foldSpan?: FoldSpan;
  /** A control after the header's words in the table header (an apply-to-all); never in folded rows. */
  headerAction?: ReactNode;
  cell: (row: T, index: number) => ReactNode;
};

export function ReviewGrid<T>({
  label,
  columns,
  rows,
  rowKey,
  rowId,
  rowClassName,
  flush = false,
  fold = 'md',
}: {
  /** What the rows fold by: the viewport (`md`, default) or the grid's own width (`container`). */
  fold?: 'md' | 'container';
  /** Sits directly in a card (under its header): no border of its own, phone rows split by hairlines instead of boxed. */
  flush?: boolean;
  /** Names the table for screen readers. */
  label: string;
  columns: readonly ReviewGridColumn<T>[];
  rows: readonly T[];
  rowKey: (row: T, index: number) => string;
  rowId?: (row: T, index: number) => string | undefined;
  rowClassName?: (row: T, index: number) => string | undefined;
}) {
  if (fold === 'container') {
    return <ContainerGrid label={label} columns={columns} rows={rows} rowKey={rowKey} rowId={rowId} rowClassName={rowClassName} flush={flush} />;
  }
  return (
    <Table aria-label={label} className="max-md:block" containerClassName={cn('max-md:overflow-visible max-md:rounded-none max-md:border-0 max-md:bg-transparent', flush && 'rounded-none border-0')}>
      <THead className="bg-surface max-md:hidden">
        <tr>
          {columns.map((column, index) => (
            <TH key={column.key} alignRight={column.numeric} className={cn('px-2 py-2', flush ? 'first:pl-5 last:pr-5' : 'first:pl-3 last:pr-3', index === 0 && 'md:sticky md:left-0 md:z-10 md:bg-surface', column.className)}>
              {column.bare ? <span className="sr-only">{column.header}</span> : column.header}
              {column.headerAction ? <span className="ml-1 inline-flex align-middle">{column.headerAction}</span> : null}
            </TH>
          ))}
        </tr>
      </THead>
      <TBody className={flush ? 'divide-y divide-border max-md:flex max-md:flex-col' : 'divide-y divide-border max-md:flex max-md:flex-col max-md:gap-3 max-md:divide-y-0'}>
        {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
          <TR
            key={rowKey(row, rowIndex)}
            id={rowId?.(row, rowIndex)}
            className={cn('max-md:grid max-md:grid-cols-2 max-md:gap-3', flush ? 'max-md:px-5 max-md:py-4' : 'max-md:rounded-container max-md:border max-md:border-border max-md:bg-bg max-md:p-4', rowClassName?.(row, rowIndex))}
          >
            {columns.map((column, index) => (
              <TD
                key={column.key}
                alignRight={column.numeric}
                className={cn(
                  flush ? 'px-2 py-2 align-top first:pl-5 last:pr-5' : 'px-2 py-1.5 align-top first:pl-3 last:pr-3',
                  'max-md:col-span-2 max-md:p-0 max-md:text-left max-md:first:pl-0 max-md:last:pr-0',
                  column.numeric && 'tabular-nums max-md:col-span-1',
                  index === 0 && 'md:sticky md:left-0 md:z-10 md:bg-bg',
                  column.className,
                )}
              >
                {column.bare ? null : <span aria-hidden="true" className="mb-1 block text-detail font-medium text-ink md:hidden">{column.header}</span>}
                {column.cell(row, rowIndex)}
              </TD>
            ))}
          </TR>
        ))}
      </TBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

/** `fold="container"`: the same grid folding by its own width (`@container`, `@max-lg` = below 32rem). */
function ContainerGrid<T>({
  label,
  columns,
  rows,
  rowKey,
  rowId,
  rowClassName,
  flush,
}: {
  label: string;
  columns: readonly ReviewGridColumn<T>[];
  rows: readonly T[];
  rowKey: (row: T, index: number) => string;
  rowId?: (row: T, index: number) => string | undefined;
  rowClassName?: (row: T, index: number) => string | undefined;
  flush: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="@container min-w-0">
      <Table aria-label={label} className="@max-lg:block" containerClassName={cn('@max-lg:overflow-visible @max-lg:rounded-none @max-lg:border-0 @max-lg:bg-transparent', flush && 'rounded-none border-0')}>
        <THead className="bg-surface @max-lg:hidden">
          <tr>
            {columns.map((column, index) => (
              <TH key={column.key} alignRight={column.numeric} className={cn('px-2 py-2', flush ? 'first:pl-5 last:pr-5' : 'first:pl-3 last:pr-3', index === 0 && '@lg:sticky @lg:left-0 @lg:z-10 @lg:bg-surface', column.className)}>
                {column.bare ? <span className="sr-only">{column.header}</span> : column.header}
                {column.headerAction ? <span className="ml-1 inline-flex align-middle">{column.headerAction}</span> : null}
              </TH>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </THead>
        <TBody className={flush ? 'divide-y divide-border @max-lg:flex @max-lg:flex-col' : 'divide-y divide-border @max-lg:flex @max-lg:flex-col @max-lg:gap-3 @max-lg:divide-y-0'}>
          {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
            <TR
              key={rowKey(row, rowIndex)}
              id={rowId?.(row, rowIndex)}
              className={cn('@max-lg:grid @max-lg:grid-flow-row-dense @max-lg:grid-cols-6 @max-lg:gap-x-3 @max-lg:gap-y-2.5', flush ? '@max-lg:px-5 @max-lg:py-4' : '@max-lg:rounded-container @max-lg:border @max-lg:border-border @max-lg:bg-bg @max-lg:p-4', rowClassName?.(row, rowIndex))}
            >
              {columns.map((column, index) => (
                <TD
                  key={column.key}
                  alignRight={column.numeric}
                  className={cn(
                    flush ? 'px-2 py-2 align-top first:pl-5 last:pr-5' : 'px-2 py-1.5 align-top first:pl-3 last:pr-3',
                    '@max-lg:p-0 @max-lg:text-left @max-lg:first:pl-0 @max-lg:last:pr-0',
                    FOLD_SPAN[column.foldSpan ?? (column.numeric ? 3 : 6)],
                    column.numeric && 'tabular-nums',
                    index === 0 && '@lg:sticky @lg:left-0 @lg:z-10 @lg:bg-bg',
                    column.className,
                  )}
                >
                  {column.bare ? null : <span aria-hidden="true" className="mb-1 block text-detail font-medium text-ink @lg:hidden">{column.header}</span>}
                  {column.cell(row, rowIndex)}
                </TD>
              ))}
            </TR>
          ))}
        </TBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
